sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Clinical Diagnostic ELISA Assays and Reagents

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (Unitary National Jurisdiction; registered companies administered centrally by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission in Port Vila)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English common law heritage with French civil law influence and customary law; corporate and offshore company legislation follows the English exempt-company model.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus) — in force for Vanuatu
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement — Vanuatu, Fiji, Solomon Islands, Papua New Guinea
Commonwealth Investment Guarantee Framework (bilateral investment protection arrangement with the United Kingdom)

Note: Vanuatu imposes no income tax, no capital gains tax and no withholding tax; no comprehensive double taxation agreements are in force, and International Companies operate under a statutory tax-exempt offshore regime.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act No. 11 of 1992, as amended (formation, name clearance, registered agent and register of members obligations); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 55 of 2018, as amended (customer due diligence, beneficial owner identification at 25% or more, PEP screening and 5-year record retention); Financial Transactions Reporting Act No. 2 of 2002, as amended (cash transaction and international funds transfer reporting to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit); International Service Providers Act No. 6 of 2008 and International Service Providers Regulations Order No. 52 of 2009 (licensing of trust and company service providers and AML/CFT compliance obligations); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 1993 (VFSC supervisory and enforcement powers); applicable VFSC Practice Directions and Financial Intelligence Unit guidance notes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the Certificate of Incorporation and constitutional documents of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Original company registry or notary public in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a Contracting Party to the Apostille Convention since 2011) OR Consular Legalization through a Vanuatu diplomatic/consular mission for non-Convention states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Fact of the ultimate corporate shareholder
Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the licensed Vanuatu registered agent to file incorporation documents and act as statutory agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of the shareholder or director

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof of residential address of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner, director and corporate officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or Commissioner for Oaths in the person's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Declaration Form signed by each UBO disclosing the full ownership chain and any nominee arrangements
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant company with signatures notarized before a Notary Public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency listing the initial directors and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu licensed registered agent after completion of AML/CFT verification
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a Vanuatu notary plus Apostille by the Vanuatu Department of Foreign Affairs where the certificate is to be relied upon abroad

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, beneficial owners, intended major counterparties and beneficiary banks against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit watchlists, supplemented by a commercial PEP database covering politically exposed persons (heads of state, senior government, judiciary, military, and state-owned enterprise leadership, and their close associates and family). Negative screening certifications must be documented in the AML/CFT file retained by the registered agent for a minimum of 5 years; any positive match triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification and a Suspicious Transaction Report where required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registrar of International Companies, VFSC Online Name Reservation and Company Search Facility (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be stated in the Latin alphabet, in English or French script; Bislama names are permitted only in Latin transliteration. The name must end with a recognized corporate designator, in practice 'Limited' or 'Ltd' for international companies, and must be distinguishable from every name already registered or reserved in Vanuatu, including local companies, international companies, and protected names. The name must not falsely imply a connection with the Government of the Republic of Vanuatu, the VFSC, an international organization, or any regulated activity for which no license is held.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the VFSC e-portal issues a written rejection notice stating the ground, typically similarity to an existing name, prohibited token, or misleading connotation. The applicant through its licensed registered agent may file Form VFSC-NAME-APPEAL within 14 days of the rejection notice, addressed to the Registrar of International Companies, with supporting submissions distinguishing the name from the cited conflicting name or evidencing the requisite ministerial approval for a sensitive token. The Registrar must respond within 10 business days. Alternatively, the agent may immediately re-file an amended name at a reduced fee; the 30-day reservation period recommences only upon successful re-clearance. A decision of the Registrar may be further elevated to the VFSC Board of Commissioners as a final administrative remedy.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for offshore administration: the International Company must at all times maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the premises of its VFSC-licensed registered agent, but the commercial wholesale distribution of diagnostic ELISA reagents and IVD products may be managed entirely remotely, provided the company does not carry on business with Vanuatu-resident persons or derive income from Vanuatu sources, which is prohibited for an International Company under the International Companies Act. A physical presence in Vanuatu would only be required if the entity voluntarily obtains a local importer's license for medical devices or IVD reagents under the Pharmacy Act regime, in which case a licensed premises and compliance with Vanuatu's Medicines and Diagnostics regulatory framework would apply; this is optional and outside the standard exempt-company structure.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated below 5% annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection for a standard low-risk International Company maintaining no Vanuatu domestic trade license; elevated to 30-50% if the company applies for a Vanuatu medical/IVD importer license, registers for VAT or holds a physical staffed office in Port Vila, reflecting enhanced supervisory attention under the AML/CFT framework.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent — incorporation filing, registered office, UBO register maintenance and statutory representation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for low-risk wholesale distribution KYC pack covering 50-150 screened records across shareholders, directors, beneficial owners and counterparties

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public(s) in the respective jurisdictions of shareholders and individuals
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff, varying by country of origin (commonly Hong Kong, Singapore, Sydney)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille certification of the notarized corporate documents bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent Apostille authority of each issuing state (e.g., Singapore Academy of Law, Hong Kong High Court Apostille Section)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document apostille fee multiplied by the required bundle of approximately 3-5 documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization contingency for documents originating in non-Apostille Convention states

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular fee or third-party legalization courier fee, estimated at ruling rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Expedited incorporation processing and secured digital certificate delivery
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed agent / courier with VFSC e-registry integration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for expedited processing and encrypted certificate transmission

incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies Division
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form IC-1) with Registration Statement and Consent of Registered Agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; no escrow deposit required. Issued share capital may be denominated in any convertible currency; full or partial payment must be recorded in the register and confirmed by board resolution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers’ allotment of ordinary shares be confirmed, and that the officers of the Company be appointed immediately following registration; RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the address provided by the licensed registered agent and that the Company adopt the Memorandum and Articles as filed; RESOLVED FURTHER that the directors be authorized to open bank accounts, engage the registered agent, and complete all filings required under Vanuatu law; RESOLVED that the chairperson and any one director or the company secretary be authorized to execute ancillary documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies Registry (online portal www.vfsc.vu)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search/reservation request via the VFSC online filing system or through a licensed registered agent. Ensure the proposed name does not contain a restricted expression such as 'bank', 'trust', 'insurance', 'assurance' or a government designation, and does not conflict with an existing International Company name. Pay the prescribed search/reservation fee and obtain the Certificate of Reservation.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name in Latin script
Identity of the applicant or licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, submit an administrative objection to VFSC Registry with a memorandum of grounds, propose an alternate distinctive name, or appeal under the International Companies Act review procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of incorporation dossiers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, stating the company name, registered office details, capital structure, object clause and share classes. The registered agent must execute the consent to act in the prescribed form, and the subscriber(s) must sign the incorporation documents. All signatures may be affixed by means acceptable to the Registry and must be witnessed in compliance with the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Declaration as to non-resident status if applicable
Letter from the registered agent confirming identity of directors and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries any document for formal defects, cure the stated deficiency by filing a corrective amendment or revised signed document and re-submit within 30 days of the query notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Fee Collection Desk / official banking channel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official state filing fee (US$350 approximate) together with the annual registered agent and registered office fees. Payment is made by telegraphic transfer or via the VFSC e-payment facility referencing the reserved company name. Retain the payment receipt as proof of filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In the event of a fee dispute or of a receipt mismatch, provide the bank confirmation and date-stamped payment Advice to VFSC Finance Department; any underpayment must be settled within the payment reconciliation window to avoid rejection of the incorporation application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and registration of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Memorandum and Articles, Form IC-1, consent of the registered agent, and all required dossiers with the VFSC Registry. The Registry reviews the filings for statutory compliance and, upon satisfaction, issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The incorporated entity becomes a separate legal person on the date of issue of the certificate.
required_dossiers: Proof of registered office address in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a requisition, respond with a corrected filing within 14 days and attend to any requisition letter issued under the International Companies Act; seeking an expedited cure is available by ministerial request upon showing of prejudice due to delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of directors, company secretary, and registered agent recordal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry in coordination with the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File notices of appointment of the first directors, company secretary (if any), and registered agent using the Registry's prescribed forms. Confirm that at least one director is a natural person unless a corporate director is expressly permitted by the articles, and record the names and addresses in the public register within the statutory period. Obtain written consents of the appointed directors and secretary.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry refuses to record a director due to disqualification or defective documentation, replace the individual by filing a revised appointment and request administrative withdrawal of the defective filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of share capital and maintenance of statutory registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company board of directors / registered agent as custodian
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting (or circulate written resolution) to allot subscribed shares, adopt the registered office, and appoint officers as set out in the pro forma resolution. Complete the register of members, register of directors, and register of charges in accordance with the International Companies Act; no public filing of the owner registry is required but the register must be kept at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Register of beneficial owners for AML purposes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a statutory register is found deficient during inspection or by VFSC request, effect within 21 days a rectification schedule approved by the board and file any corrective notice required by the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation company secretarial and annual compliance set-up
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission / VFSC annual return unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the annual return and pay the annual renewal fee with VFSC in each calendar year. Appoint or confirm the continuation of the registered agent, ensure the agent filing is in place for the next year and prepare minutes of the annual general meeting or written resolution in lieu thereof, as permitted under the articles.
required_dossiers: Registered agent consent for continuing term
Copy of AGM minutes or written resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon late filing, apply to VFSC for reinstatement of the filing record by payment of the late fee; failure to cure may lead to striking-off, for which a restoration application to the Registry or the Court is available.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Health (Pharmacy and Drugs Unit); Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) for investment approvals where applicable
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Wholesale Medical Supply and Diagnostic Reagent Import License / Pharmacy Wholesale Distribution Permit issued under the Medicines Act (Cap. 142)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: EIA Registration (Category B) — full EIA report only for facilities exceeding small-scale cold storage or biological waste thresholds; wholesale IVD reagent distribution with limited on-site storage is normally subject to environmental registration and an Environment Permit Application
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must comply with the Environment Act (Cap. 283) and the National Waste Management and Pollution Control Regulations; concentration limits apply to organic solvents, chlorine, and biohazardous laboratory waste. Cold storage refrigerants must be CFC-free. Reagent wastes must be segregated and manifested through a licensed waste carrier for incineration or authorized treatment; VOC emissions from cleaning agents and solvent residues must remain below national workplace exposure thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate and annual inspection from Vanuatu Police Fire and Rescue Service; structural load inspection by the Department of Public Works for any cold-room mezzanine installation; workplace chemical storage and handling clearance from the Department of Labour (Vanuatu Labour Act, Cap. 232); separate import permit from the Pharmacy and Drugs Unit together with the customs import declaration.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Commissioner of Customs and Inland Revenue, Vanuatu Customs & Inland Revenue (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management – official portal: https://www.customs.gov.vu and business/taxpayer services: https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is not within the Vanuatu income tax net and has no automatic domestic tax file. To claim zero-rated VAT or conduct VAT-relevant local transactions, the IC must submit a VAT registration application on Form VAT 01 together with the IC certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, register details, director/shareholder identification, proof of a physical or licensed registered office in Vanuatu, and evidence of intended taxable activity. The VCIR assigns a VAT/TIN number; routine IC-only offshore activity generally requires no TIN unless VAT registration is voluntarily selected.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists because Vanuatu has no corporate income tax. The International Company is statutorily tax-exempt under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; it may voluntarily elect VAT registration, but there is no entity-classification or hybrid-mismatch regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not currently mandate real-time fiscal e-invoicing, digital stamping, or continuous clearance. VAT-registered businesses may issue standard VAT invoices, in paper or electronic form, containing the required prescribed particulars. Export declarations are filed electronically through ASYCUDA World for customs clearance, but there is no tax-authority e-invoicing clearance platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to supplies of goods (including diagnostic reagents and IVD assays) that are physically exported from Vanuatu to a non-resident recipient, or provided as offshore services, provided the supplier retains contemporaneous proof of export, the goods leave Vanuatu within the statutory timeframe prescribed in the VAT Act, and the supply is evidenced by a valid export sale and transfer of ownership outside Vanuatu. A VAT-registered IC may claim zero-rating if it holds and submits the required export documentation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill showing overseas destination
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT or TT credit advice
VAT export schedule or exporter declaration substantiating zero-rating
Certificate of Free Sale or export permit for human diagnostic products (where applicable)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner may audit export substantiation and re-characterize unproven zero-rated supplies as taxable, resulting in VAT assessed at 12.5%, interest for late payment, penalties for false or negligent declarations, and clawback of any input VAT credits or refunds claimed. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims can attract criminal prosecution under the VAT Act and Customs Act, including monetary penalties and potential forfeiture of goods or profits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 123]; exchange control is administered under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 75] and its Regulations, with the RBV delegating daily approval authority to licensed authorised dealers (commercial banks). The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) supervises corporate registries and financial dealers but does not operate the FX regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) floats under a managed basket administered by the RBV; current-account payments for trade in goods and services are freely processed by authorised dealers under delegated authority using statutory forms (notably Form A2), while capital-account transactions require RBV approval unless a statutory exemption applies. The decisive exemption for the International Company (IC) is the exchange-control exemption in the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]: transactions routed through an IC's foreign-currency account held with an authorised dealer are outside the Exchange Control Act. Consequently, USD-denominated equity injections, trade collections, and dividend remittances by the IC are effectively fully convertible, with no withholding tax on outbound dividends; only VUV transactions with Vanuatu residents require exchange-control clearance. Overall onshore convertibility for this ISIC 4649 IVD distributor is assessed as High for USD treasury flows and Medium for VUV conversion capacity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory conversion ratio applies to export proceeds (0% surrender requirement). Vanuatu's exchange-control framework requires exports above the prescribed threshold to be declared (goods declaration and exchange-control export form), and export proceeds must be repatriated to Vanuatu within the statutory period (generally six months from shipment, or such extended period approved by the RBV or an authorised dealer). The IC may retain all USD export collections in its foreign-currency account, may offset them against import payments, or may rotate them to an offshore group treasury account where the dealer's conditions permit; there is no statutory obligation to sell VUV into the market.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Foreign-Currency Operational Account (FCA) with VUV current-account overlay; escrow capability for capital injections
USD Foreign-Currency Operational Account and VUV Trade Settlement Account
USD Operational Account / Capital Escrow Account
VUV Settlement Account; USD FCA only on enhanced credit approval

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for offshore digital EMIs. Vanuatu has no dedicated electronic money institution licensing track, and the RBV's exchange-control exemption for ICs operates only through authorised dealers. Global correspondent banks treat Vanuatu ICs clearing through non-bank EMI platforms as an elevated shell-company risk, and EMIs cannot issue the SWIFT MT103 / commercial LC instruments required for clinical-diagnostic reagent trade. EMIs are acceptable only as an auxiliary collection gateway, never as the primary settlement rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one natural-person director and all account signatories must complete an in-person KYC interview at the bank's Port Vila (or Luganville) branch; a VFSC-licensed registered agent may pre-vet the corporate pack, but the bank's Money Laundering Reporting Officer retains final sign-off. Remote opening is permitted only for low-risk structures and is conditioned on certified passport copies, a banker's reference for each beneficial owner, source-of-funds evidence, and a recorded video interview; in practice the IC's directors should budget one Port Vila visit for execution of the banking mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu jurisdiction risk: historic FATF increased-monitoring and EU tax-list episodes cause elevated negative-news scoring at foreign correspondent and onshore banks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC good-standing certificate; beneficial-ownership and AML/CFT Act compliance certificates; APG mutual-evaluation follow-up status where relevant; group AML policy; board rationale for the Vanuatu holding/distribution structure; and documentary proof of the legitimate IVD trade chain (supplier agreements, WHO/CE/ISO certificates for ELISA assay products).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shell-like single-purpose International Company with 100% non-resident ownership and no in-country substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Port Vila office lease; registered-office and registered-agent certificates; annual returns and accounting records; local director or exempted-company administrator appointment; foreign investment registration certificate if any business is carried on in Vanuatu; supplier and distributor contracts; three-year business plan supporting the ISIC 4649 wholesale reagent operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctioned-corridor or public-health third-country exports: clinical reagents invoiced to government ministries or distributors in screened jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: End-user certificate and final-consignee declaration; HS 3822 classification justification; CE/FDA/WHO prequalification documentation for the diagnostic products; restricted-party screening output; destination-country import permit; complete shipping set (commercial invoice, packing list, airway bill); and internal trade-compliance attestation by the compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Alternative-remittance patterns: back-to-back payments, third-party settlements, or high-frequency low-value wires inconsistent with wholesale reagent value bands.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal treasury policy restricting payments to named suppliers; purchase-order-to-bank-entry reconciliation; supplier KYC register with entity verification; five-year record retention under the AML/CFT Act; and monthly compliance pack (Form A2 copies, SWIFT confirmations, aged receivables) furnished to the bank's relationship manager.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders subscribe equity or advance shareholder loans in USD via SWIFT MT103 to the IC's USD FCA at the authorised dealer. Because the IC's foreign-currency account is exempt from exchange control under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], the inward credit requires no RBV approval and no Form A2; the bank requires a board resolution authorising the account and issuance, share-allotment and loan agreements, UBO declarations, source-of-funds affidavits, and a funds-flow narrative tying the remitter to the registered shareholder. If the group prefers VUV on-shore capital, the standard exchange-control inward declaration and proof of underlying capital transaction apply. Recommended MT103 beneficiary field: the IC's USD FCA at the Port Vila authorised dealer, with purpose stated as direct investment or intercompany loan; the dealer routes via its Australia/New Zealand/US correspondent for final clearing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement to offshore manufacturers of IVD reagents and consumables is executed through SWIFT MT103 (TT) instructions debiting the USD FCA; for large or repeat purchase orders the bank opens an irrevocable sight commercial letter of credit (MT700), optionally confirmed by the beneficiary's bank, to control supply risk. VUV-denominated local disbursements (registered agent, freight, port handling, local consignment warehouse) require Form A2 conversion filings. A complete disbursement package comprises the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, air/sea waybill, destination-country import licence, and HS 3822 classification note; the bank's trade desk will release MT103/MT700 messages only against this documentation set to preserve audit integrity.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV outright forwards with authorised dealers, tenors matched to the trade-receivable cycle (normally 30-180 days)
Offshore non-deliverable VUV forwards (NDFs) executed by the group treasury with international bank counterparties when settlement currency remains USD
Cross-currency swaps and covered interest-rate swaps between VUV and USD through the group's offshore treasury centre with RBV-authorised counterparty documentation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Solvency Declaration (International Company form prescribed under the International Companies Act, Cap. 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies and International Trusts Registry, Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts VUV 50,000 (approximately USD 430) monetary penalty; failure to remedy within 60 days of the due date triggers a VFSC strike-off notice, with administrative dissolution and escheat of assets to the Republic of Vanuatu after the statutory notice period

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (offshore license and registered agent continuity payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — remitted through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, on or before the incorporation anniversary; VFSC administrative grace period of 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment by the anniversary date incurs a monthly late surcharge (approximately 10% of the annual fee); continued default for 3 months results in administrative strike-off of the International Company from the Register

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None — the Vanuatu International Companies Act (Cap. 222) imposes no mandatory statutory audit on International Companies; an independent audit is required only if the company's articles of incorporation so provide or if shareholders holding at least 5% of voting rights request one
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No accounting framework is mandated by statute for the exempt International Company; financial records are customarily maintained under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or simplified internal cash-basis statements; no financial statements are filed with VFSC given the statutory tax-exempt status

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no public beneficial ownership register and there is no separate statutory annual UBO return; the licensed registered agent, acting under the VFSC AML/CFT regime, must keep the beneficial ownership and shareholding records current, conduct an annual customer due diligence refresh, and document each transfer of shares or change in ultimate beneficial ownership; any change of directors or registered agent is separately lodged with VFSC within the statutory amendment period

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 – 1,500 per annum for licensed corporate services provider, including registered office, registered agent, and annual return filing support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 statutory; market-rate certified audit or reviewed accounts fee USD 1,500 – 3,500 per annum where required by banking counterparties or as internal governance

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (nil). Vanuatu is a zero-direct-tax jurisdiction: no corporate income tax, no profits tax, no capital gains tax, and no payroll tax. An International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from every present and future Vanuatu tax on income, assets, or transactions under the International Companies Act (Cap 222).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Nil effective tax on profits; no tax holiday or preferential deduction is required because the base rate is zero. The IC bears only fixed statutory charges: (i) a graduated VFSC annual license fee based on authorized share capital, (ii) registered agent fees, and (iii) VAT at 12.5% strictly on domestic taxable supplies in Vanuatu, with offshore wholesale export of IVD diagnostic reagents falling outside the VAT net or zero-rated. No loss-carryforward relief exists because there is no income tax against which losses could be offset.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The mandatory recurring filing is the International Company Annual Return and Annual License Fee, submitted to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via the VFSC online company registry portal or through the licensed Vanuatu registered agent. The filing is coupled with the IC's annual beneficial ownership (BO) record update.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual license fee is payable on or before each anniversary of the date of incorporation; the Annual Return must be lodged within one month after each anniversary. Filing and payment are due even if the IC had zero activity, zero income, zero assets, or no business plan.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, registration number, date of incorporation, authorized and issued share capital, currency, class of shares, and share premium; the annual fee band is derived from authorized capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs must submit the filing and fee via the licensed local registered agent; no profit computation or tax assessment is annexed because no CIT regime applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current physical address of the registered office in Vanuatu and full particulars of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical registered office and a licensed agent in Port Vila are mandatory; the agent serves as the address for legal process and statutory notices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, former names, residential addresses, nationalities, appointment dates, and shareholding details of all directors and members.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors/shareholders are permissible, but ultimate beneficial owners must be disclosed to the registered agent and recorded in the BO register, which the VFSC may access under the IC Act and international exchange-of-information arrangements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of the IC's actual business type and confirmation that no business has been transacted with Vanuatu residents and no licensed or prohibited Vanuatu domestic activity has been undertaken.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC is ring-fenced: it may not trade with Vanuatu residents, solicit business from the Vanuatu public, own Vanuatu real estate, or conduct banking, insurance, or trust business in Vanuatu without ministerial consent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement by the registered agent confirming payment of the annual fee, maintenance of BO records, and absence of breach of the International Companies Act, the AML/CTF legislation, and applicable international sanctions obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent attests on behalf of the non-resident beneficial owner; BO records must be current and producible within the statutory timeframe upon request by the VFSC or foreign competent authorities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment of the annual license fee triggers an immediate prescribed late-payment surcharge and, after the statutory grace period, exposes the IC to administrative strike-off and deregistration by the Registrar. A struck-off IC loses its legal capacity, and its assets may be forfeited to the state. Lodging false statements with the VFSC is a criminal offence punishable by fines up to approximately VT 1,000,000 (or the amended statutory ceiling) and imprisonment of responsible officers. Directors and agents are jointly exposed to administrative penalties and disqualification.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends, distributions, capital gains, or liquidation proceeds paid by an International Company to its non-resident shareholders. Dividends are remitted gross with no deduction at source.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs) in force and consequently no domestic treaty-relief machinery, no MAP/arbitration procedure, and no WHT-reduction application protocol. Because the domestic withholding rate is zero, repatriated dividends are never reduced by Vanuatu; taxation occurs solely in the shareholder's residence jurisdiction. If a foreign tax authority requires proof of Vanuatu status, the VFSC or the Department of Finance and Treasury may issue a certificate of non-residence/tax-exemption confirming that no Vanuatu income tax was levied on the IC.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding for cross-border royalties (IP licensing of diagnostic trademarks, formulas, and distribution know-how) and debt interest: 0% in Vanuatu; no treaty rates exist because the DTA network is absent. A Vanuatu IC may therefore license IVD-related IP or service intercompany debt at zero domestic withholding. The counterparty jurisdiction remains free to impose its own non-resident withholding, interest-limitation, royalty anti-abuse, CFC, and hybrid mismatch rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in Vanuatu: domestic law prescribes no mandatory Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country reporting threshold, no transfer pricing return form, and no advance pricing agreement procedure because the IC is fully tax-exempt. The operative TP documentation obligation arises extraterritorially from the foreign related-party jurisdiction applying OECD-aligned transfer pricing rules once its statutory revenue or related-party transaction thresholds are crossed.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not currently maintain a standalone Economic Substance Regulations statute for International Companies. Substance requirements nevertheless operate indirectly: (i) the IC Act ring-fences the entity — no local business with residents, no local land ownership — so the IC must evidence a genuine offshore commercial purpose; (ii) Vanuatu's FATF increased-monitoring status (grey list June 2021) and EU listing cycle (blacklisted 2020–2023, delisted after beneficial-ownership and exchange-of-information reforms) oblige ICs to demonstrate transparent governance; (iii) a letterbox company is exposed to foreign CFC inclusion, permanent-establishment assertions, and banking de-risking. Recommended substance for an IVD reagent distribution IC: physical office in Port Vila, licensed resident registered agent, substantive board minutes, locally maintained books and records, and complete commercial documentation (contracts, purchase orders, invoices, shipping records) proving that only offshore business is transacted.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion and fraudulent concealment abroad
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the zero-tax IC to conceal foreign-source commercial income from the beneficial owner's tax authority (e.g., undeclared distributorship margins on ELISA/IVD reagents), or submitting false or materially incomplete declarations to the VFSC, the registered agent, or a foreign revenue service while relying on CRS/FATCA opacity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: criminal fines for false filings under the International Companies Act (up to approximately VT 1,000,000 or the amended ceiling) and imprisonment of responsible officers; AML/CTF prosecution for money laundering connected to tax fraud. Foreign jurisdiction: full reassessment, interest, fraud penalties of 100–400% of tax evaded, asset freezing, and proceeds-of-crime confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts pierce the veil where the IC is a sham or mere façade: directors and beneficial owners become jointly and severally liable for unpaid foreign tax, civil restitution, interest, and penalties; personal travel bans, INTERPOL red notices, extradition requests, and imprisonment terms of 5–10 years are realistic personal consequences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a letterbox IC with no Vanuatu physical presence, no local books or records, no board activity, with management and control exercised exclusively from a high-tax jurisdiction, and claiming offshore or zero-tax benefits without real commercial substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: VFSC administrative penalties, rejection of the annual attestation, and strike-off/deregistration for non-filing or non-payment. International: re-escalation of Vanuatu on the EU/OECD lists triggering defensive measures; foreign tax authorities may recharacterize income as domestically sourced, apply CFC income inclusion, assert a permanent establishment, and impose penalties and interest on the full underpayment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors resident in the foreign jurisdiction face enforcement orders, director disqualification, and personal liability for corporate tax where the company is disregarded as a separate entity; courts may issue contribution orders requiring directors to fund the company's tax liabilities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain a current beneficial ownership register, refusing to disclose BO information to the VFSC or foreign competent authorities, transacting with sanctioned or terrorist-linked counterparties, ignoring suspicious-transaction reporting obligations, or using the IC for invoice fraud or trade-based money laundering in the IVD commodities sector.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu AML/CFT framework (post-FATF-grey-list aligned): substantial corporate fines, suspension or revocation of the IC's status, deregistration, and confiscation of proceeds of crime; foreign sanctions enforcement adds asset freezes, correspondent-banking restrictions, and secondary penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and shadow directors are individually prosecutable; sanctions include personal fines, disqualification, imprisonment up to 15 years for serious money-laundering under Vanuatu law, asset-confiscation orders, and travel restrictions pending extradition within the FATF mutual-recognition network.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed domestic activity by an International Company
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC breaches its ring-fence by supplying ELISA/IVD reagents to Vanuatu hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, or distributors, acquiring Vanuatu real estate, or engaging in any local business without ministerial consent and without the licences required by the International Companies Act and the Business Licence Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC commits a criminal offence punishable by a fine of up to approximately VT 1,000,000 (or the amended ceiling), may forfeit its statutory tax exemption and separate legal-person protections, and may be struck off by the VFSC; contracts concluded with Vanuatu residents may be void and unenforceable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally fined, ordered to compensate the company or third parties, and disqualified from acting as directors; the corporate veil is lifted for the prohibited transactions, rendering directors personally liable on the unauthorized contracts.
